description: This Java source file defines the PolicySupervisorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing PolicyPersistenceActor instances. It handles creation, supervision, and restart logic for actor lifecycle management, including back-off strategies and failure handling. The class includes methods for actor instantiation, configuration, and exception management within the context of policy persistence supervision.

classes.name: PolicySupervisorActor
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractPersistenceSupervisor, supervising PolicyPersistenceActor instances, providing lifecycle management, failure handling, and configuration for policy persistence.
